t: A build-it-yourself model of NASA's Mars rovers made from printed parts.
steps: Read the docs folder in the Sawppy_Rover repo on GitHub, starting with the parts list and price breakdown.
Order the aluminum extrusions, ten LX-16A servos, shafts, screws, and a Raspberry Pi 3.
Print the STL files for every bracket and wheel.
Give each servo its own ID one at a time with the BusLinker board. Every servo ships as ID 1.
Assemble the rocker-bogie frame and steering corners from the build docs.
Install the SGVHAK Rover software on the Raspberry Pi.
Open the rover's web page on a phone and take your first drive.
